consequence.statement: New compatibility profiles are available in Istio 1.24; operators upgrading from earlier versions can apply the 1.23 profile to maintain compatibility with older version behavior patterns.

assertion.statement: Istio 1.24 introduces a new 1.23 compatibility profile and updates other profiles to account for 1.24 changes, with the 1.23 profile setting specific feature gates and environment variables for backward compatibility.
